A 0.500 mL/min feed gives the batch-matched nominal 10.0 min residence time. However, the protocol omits the boronic-acid identity/equivalents, base identity/equivalents, palladium identity/loading, and batch concentration; microwave irradiation also cannot be reproduced with the listed inventory. It is only suitable if the complete formulation is homogeneous and remains pumpable at room temperature for the planned run.\",\"pre_reactor_steps\":[\"Using only the reported reaction components and DMF, prepare 16.0 mL of feed containing 1.60 mmol aromatic bromide, corresponding to 0.100 M, plus the phenylboronic acid derivative, base, and palladium catalyst at their validated batch ratios/loadings.\",\"Stir until the feed is visibly homogeneous. Do not proceed with this single-stream design if undissolved base, catalyst, or other solids remain, because no solids-handling or filtration equipment is listed.\",\"Charge the homogeneous feed to Syringe pump A and prime the 1.0 mm ID PFA tubing and 5 mL PFA coil with feed before collecting a timed fraction.\",\"Set the coil temperature controller to exactly 50.0 C and allow the coil to equilibrate before initiating the timed experiment.\"],\"post_reactor_steps\":[\"Discharge the coil directly to an atmospheric collection vessel; no BPR is used.\",\"After three nominal residence times (30 min; 15.0 mL pumped), collect the steady-state fraction for analysis.\",\"Continue only while flow is stable and the outlet remains free-flowing. Analyze conversion and product yield by the laboratory's validated analytical method; no analytical method was provided in the source protocol.\"],\"chemistry_notes\":[\"This is a Suzuki-type palladium cross-coupling inference based on the aromatic bromide, arylboronic acid derivative, base, and palladium catalyst described in the source protocol.\",\"The screen preserves the validated batch temperature of 50 C and the 10 min nominal reaction time, but does not reproduce microwave energy deposition.
